question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Perceive
solution:
The correct answer is '**Recognize**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Perceive**' is '**Recognize**'.
 
• **Perceive**: to notice or realize something. (इंद्रियों द्वारा ग्रहण करना, देखना, जानना, बोध होना)
 
 
• *Example: Scientists failed to **perceive** how dangerous the level of pollution had become.*
 
 
 
• **Recognize**: to know again somebody/something that you have seen or heard before. [किसी को पहचानना (पहले देखे या सुने को दुबारा जानना)]
 
 
• *Example: I **recognized** him but I couldn’t remember his name.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Recognize.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Declare**: to state something publicly and officially or to make something known in a firm, clear way. [(कोई बात) सार्वजनिक और आधिकारिक रूप से घोषित करना, (किसी बात की) घोषणा करना]
 
• **Present**: existing or happening now. (वर्तमान, मौजूदा, इस समय का)
 
• **Discuss**: to talk or write about something seriously or formally. [(लेख या भाषण के रूप में) गंभीर विचार-विमर्श करना]
